name: Climate Destruction
description: They cut down ancient forests and took down old villages just to excavate lignite in this open-pit coal mine. Like there aren't alternative options to gain energy. name: Shaken, not stirred!
description:
Ingredients:
- 3 ounces Gordon's Gin
- 1 ounce vodka
- 1/2 ounce Kina Lillet.

Instructions:
Fill a shaker with ice and pour in the ingredients.
Shake until it's ice cold.
Strain the mixture into a champagne saucer.
Garnish with a slice of lemon.

name: Moon of Change
description:
An interesting experiment made to test one of the filters included in the G'MIC-qt GIMP plugin.
This one uses the Layers Blend[Fade] filter, combining different layers by fading them according to either a formula or one of the predefined forms (This one uses the Circle option, and the effect is produced entirely by varying the Offset parameter by small increments !)
The other filter used for the return-to-start part is the Morph Layers filter.
Source Image : https://pixabay.com/illustrations/silhouette-nature-darkness-dawn-3243695
